title: Rav Huna son of Rava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Kamma 72a, rejecting the difficulty that Rav Chavivi of Mechoza had raised against Rav Ashi; Rav Ashi said to him, “Do not reject it.” Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Acha son of Rava, as cited there at 72b.[^1]

notes.text: The checked Bava Kamma 72a passage has Rav Chavivi of Mechoza questioning Rav Ashi; its 72b continuation names Rav Acha son of Rava, whom Rav Ashi tells not to dismiss the objection. Hyman’s heading and report name Rav Huna son of Rava and cite the Acha form as a Dikdukei Soferim reading. Those source forms and locators are preserved; the apparatus report has not been directly collated.
